note: Re-judged 2026-11-23 by an independent agent after checkXFRMStateScopeCapabilities, installChildDataplane and the E3 rename in rfc4301_sad_selector_linux_test.go changed. RFC 4301 Section 5.2: "Then match the packet against the inbound selectors identified by the SAD entry to verify that the received packet is appropriate for the SA via which it was received." Tested: "match the packet against the inbound selectors identified by the SAD entry". Gap: "verify that the received packet is appropriate for the SA via which it was received". Producer: internal/component/ike/engine/child.go::installChildDataplane, with internal/component/ike/engine/child_scope.go::childStateScope and internal/component/ike/dataplane/xfrm_state_scope_linux.go::checkXFRMStateScopeCapabilities. checkXFRMStateScopeCapabilities now requires ABI 0x5a450001, saStateScopeMaxSelectors, no unknown bits and required feature mask 0xef (bits 0-3 and 5-7, including xfrmZECapICMPForwardGate); installChildDataplane builds both directional scopes via childStateScope before publishing either state. TestRFC4301TunnelModeInboundSelectorsAreEnforcedByTheStateSelector (renamed from ...ByTheRequirePolicy to match its assertions) and TestRFC4301TransportModeInboundSADEntryDropsPacketsOutsideItsSelectors deliver in-selector packets and drop source, port and protocol misses at the state selector (XfrmInStateMismatch +1, XfrmInNoPols and XfrmInPolBlock unchanged in tunnel mode); TestRFC4301BareESPOnTemplatedSAIsPolicyChecked covers whole and fragmented bare ESP on an ESP-in-UDP state; TestRFC4301TransportStateSelectorIsTheNegotiatedPair and rfc4301_boundary_linux_test.go pin exact selectors. All tagged fixtures remain single-pair (TestRFC4301SiblingSAsKeepInboundSelectorsBound is untagged), so general multi-pair/sibling per-SA isolation stays unproven. Scoped evidence only; zero whole-requirement credit.
